description:
Send an app built with AI to the Vibe Shipped human review queue.
Use when: the user explicitly asks to list their own app and gives a public source (post, launch page or interview) naming the AI tool used.
Do not use for: apps the user did not ask to submit, or apps without a public source.
Returns: status pending, or isError with the validation message.
Limits: Write, not destructive: nothing is published automatically.
Example: {"title":"Habitly","url":"https://habitly.app","source_url":"https://x.com/maker/status/123","one_liner":"Habit tracker","tools":["lovable"],"builder_name":"Ana"}

source_url.description: Public post proving it was built with AI.

name: submit_app
title: Submit an app
